new='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def bands(size, cuts):
        bounds = [-1] + cuts + [size]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)]
    rb, cb = bands(h, sep_rows), bands(w, sep_cols)
    sep_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row} - sep_colors
    background = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    marks = colors - {background}
    mark = next(iter(marks))
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == mark for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) % 2 == 0 else background
             for c0, c1 in cb] for r0, r1 in rb]
'''
